reply.text: {"route": "care", "say": "I'm not going to build a plan around that one, and I'm not going to pretend I didn't hear it. Wanting to be \"skinny\" fast and being fine with hunger is a pattern I take seriously, because it can lead to real harm to your body and your health. You don't need to be smaller to be a strong athlete. If you want to talk about what's driving this, I'm willing to listen. And if the hunger or the pressure to look a certain way is getting heavy, please reach out to a doctor or a dietitian, or to someone you trust. When you're ready, we can talk about training that builds you up instead."}
